## Featured updates

[Image of a person flushing their dental unit waterlines using the A-dec Flush Dock over a sink]

#### How to Clean and Maintain Dental Unit Waterlines

Learn a clear, step-by-step approach to dental unit waterline (DUWL) maintenance—from choosing the
right water source to monitoring, shocking, and flushing treatments.

[Read article][128]
[A dental office employee looking at the Link AI inbox]

#### AI Dental Receptionist: Turn Missed Calls Into Revenue

Learn how AI dental receptionist software helps streamline scheduling, communication, and front desk
workflows.

[Read article][129]
[A-dec Impact logo]

#### A-dec Donates $1 Million to Dental Trade Alliance Foundation

A‑dec announced a transformative $1,000,000 endowment, in partnership with The Dental Trade Alliance
Foundation.

[Read press release][130]
[A-dec and Dentsply Sirona collaboration logos]

#### A-dec and Dentsply Sirona Expand Partnership

A‑dec and Dentsply Sirona expand their strategic partnership by integrating the Midwest Motor System
into A‑dec Pro delivery systems.

[Read press release][131]
[Two curved dark blue arrows containing the words A-dec Buyback Program]

#### A‑dec Buyback Program

Get cash back for your used A‑dec dental equipment.

[Learn more][132]
[Townie awards for A-dec dental equipment]

#### Thank you, Townie dentists

Since 2003, Dentaltown magazine's online community of dental professionals has consistently named
A‑dec products as the best across multiple categories.

[About the awards][133]
[3D visualization of A-dec dental equipment coming out of a phone]

#### 5 Tips and Tricks for Dream in 3D

From starting with a blank room or uploading photos of an existing space, to using AI-generated
color palettes, AR/VR visualization, and easy sharing tools, see how doctors can plan their
operatories with confidence.

[Read article][134]

## A-dec+ connected dentistry

Simple. Reliable. Intuitive. Imagine an updatable software platform that keeps your dental practice
ready for whatever lies ahead.

[Explore A-dec+][135]
[A-dec+ web and mobile application]

## Featured resources

Dream in 3D

Explore A‑dec dental equipment in 3D, and see products in your space with AR. Customize colors and
materials, and order free color samples.

[Explore Dream in 3D][136]

Order color samples

Order free A‑dec upholstery and cabinet color samples.

[Find your perfect color][137]

A‑dec buyback program

Get cash back for your A‑dec dental equipment—and get our best deal when you purchase new A‑dec
equipment at the same time.

[A-dec buyback program][138]

Customer stories

Hear why doctors choose A‑dec dental equipment to design healthy, comfortable, and high-quality
dental office experiences.

[Watch videos][139]

All Rights Reserved. ## Larry Cohen **CHIEF CUSTOMER ADVOCATE** Larry Cohen graduated from Wilkes College with a B.S. in Accounting in 1957 and Columbia University Graduate School of Business, earning an M.S. in Management and Finance, 1958. He served in the U. S. Army Reserve from 1958 through 1964. He is the second-generation owner of Benco Dental Company, which was founded by his father, Benjamin Cohen in 1930. Joining Benco Dental in 1959 as manager of the Tooth Department, in 1960, Larry became an outside sales rep, a position he enjoyed full time until 1972. Beginning that year, Larry began reducing his outside sales role and increasing his managerial duties, later becoming the president of Benco Dental from 1965 - 1996. Larry is the Founder of the American Dental Cooperative; Board, American Dental Trade Associate, plus Various ADTA committees. He sits on the Board of Wilkes University, Board of Visiting Nurses Association and the Board of Jewish Community Center. He served in the U. S. Army Reserve from 1958 through 1964. He is the second-generation owner of Benco Dental Company, which was founded by his father, Benjamin Cohen in 1930. Joining Benco Dental in 1959 as manager of the Tooth Department, in 1960, Larry became an outside sales rep, a position he enjoyed full time until 1972. Beginning that year, Larry began reducing his outside sales role and increasing his managerial duties, later becoming the president of Benco Dental from 1965 - 1996. Larry is the Founder of the American Dental Cooperative; Board, American Dental Trade Associate, plus Various ADTA committees. He sits on the Board of Wilkes University, Board of Visiting Nurses Association and the Board of Jewish Community Center. for one affordable and predictable monthly cost.][158]

# DENTAL EQUIPMENT AND SUPPLIES FROM A TRUSTED MANUFACTURER

At DENTALEZ, we have always understood what matters to dentists. Our dental products have been
carefully designed with the features you rely on most, from our revolutionary J-Chair to our smart
products with Aeras Intel.

# DENTAL EQUIPMENT AND SUPPLIES FROM A TRUSTED MANUFACTURER

At DENTALEZ, we have always understood what matters to dentists. Our dental products have been
carefully designed with the features you rely on most, from our revolutionary J-Chair to our smart
products with Aeras Intel.

## [TOTALOP ][159]

Now, we offer a first-of-its-kind solution, [TotalOp][160], an all-inclusive operatory subscription
service offering top-of-the-line chairs, compressors, vacuum, handpieces, and other leading dental
equipment, for one affordable and predictable monthly cost.

[][161]

## [DENTAL EQUIPMENT][162][][163]

Built on a foundation of premium engineering, the Forest 5400 balances durability, patient comfort,
and clinical functionality—at just the right price.

[][164]

## [DENTAL HANDPIECES ][165]

#### Star E900 Electric Handpiece System
#### Introducing an entirely ***new electric*** handpiece system from DENTALEZ.
#### *Smart Integration,
#### One Comprehensive System*

[][166]

## [DENTAL UTILITY ROOM EQUIPMENT ][167]

##  

Our Ramvac line of vacuums and compressors is renowned for its durability and reliablity; and we
continue to make them smaller, quieter, more powerful, more safe and more flexible.

[][168]

## [BE IN CONTROL WITH AERAS INTEL ][169]

DENTALEZ® smart products feature Aeras Intel that gives you the ability to collect data, share
information, and streamline your standard-of-care. This creates an ecosystem of patient care and
practice efficiency.

[][170]

## [DENTAL TEACHING AIDS, MODELS AND EQUIPMENT ][171]

We’re the industry standard in customizable teaching aids, helping prepare the next generations of
dental practitioners.

[][172]

We continue to innovate to answer the needs of our dentists and their patients. We manufacture and
supply the products and equipment that let you focus on what you do best - providing great dental
healthcare.

That’s peace of mind. Discover what DENTALEZ can do for you.

[][173]

#### [TRUSTED FOR OVER 100 YEARS][174]

Enjoy the proven performance of the brands you know and love, enhanced with cutting-edge technology
that helps you run an efficient, meticulous practice.

[LEARN MORE][175]
[][176]

#### [CUSTOMER CARE][177]

Our products are designed to provide exceptional value over the long term. That’s why they carry
some of the best warranties available, backed by responsive, expert customer service.

[YOU'RE COVERED][178]
[][179]

#### [A WELCOME COLLABORATION OF PRODUCTS AND KNOWLEDGE][180]

Dental Solutions & Technology (DSX), the sales organization from DENTALEZ, is filled with some of
the most knowledgeable sales representatives in the dental industry. Connect with your rep!

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

corporate social responsibility program.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is an amalgam separator?

Amalgam separators are devices designed to capture amalgam particles from dental office wastewater
through sedimentation, filtration, centrifugation, or a combination of these mechanisms.

The separator works by using a filtration system that separates the solid waste containing dental
amalgam from the wastewater generated during dental procedures. This helps prevent the release of
mercury and other metals into the environment and water systems, thereby reducing environmental
contamination.

Regulatory bodies in many regions mandate the use of amalgam separators in dental offices to ensure
proper disposal and handling of dental amalgam waste, thereby contributing to environmental
protection and human health safety.

Do I need an amalgam separator to comply with regulations?

To comply with the regulations, dental practices (both existing and new) require amalgam separation
units to be installed and ensure the amalgam collected is disposed of in accordance with the
regulations.

Many countries and regions have implemented regulations mandating the use of amalgam separators in
dental practices to manage and control the disposal of dental amalgam waste.

For instance, in the United Kingdom, the UK government has enforced regulations regarding the
installation and use of amalgam separators in dental practices. The specific requirements,
guidelines, and enforcement of these regulations may differ based on the local environmental agency
or governing bodies overseeing dental waste management.

It’s essential to consult with the environmental regulatory bodies, dental associations, or relevant
authorities in your area to understand the specific requirements concerning the use of amalgam
separators. They can provide accurate information on whether it’s mandatory and the specifications
for compliance with regulations regarding dental amalgam waste management in dental practices.

Are amalgam separators easy to install?

Typically, the installation process for amalgam separators, including Alvaley®, is designed to be
relatively straightforward.

Amalgam separators come with installation instructions provided by the manufacturer. These
instructions aim to guide dental professionals or technicians through the installation process,
making it user-friendly and relatively easy to set up.

However, the ease of installation can vary depending on factors such as the specific model of the
amalgam separator, if it is connected by fixed pipe then these will not be as easy as hose which
gives better flexibility given the restricted space in a surgery, the existing plumbing system in
the dental office, and the individual’s familiarity with plumbing or installation procedures.

Many amalgam separators, including Alvaley®, are designed for simple installation and can be
connected directly to the existing plumbing system of a dental practice. Often, they are designed to
be compact and easily mounted in a convenient location. Instructions and guidance from the
manufacturer are typically provided to assist with the installation process.

If you’re considering installing an Alvaley® amalgam separator or any similar dental equipment, it’s
recommended to follow the provided instructions carefully. Additionally, if you encounter any
challenges during the installation process, seeking guidance from a professional plumber or
contacting the manufacturer’s support for assistance can be helpful.

How often should an amalgam separator be changed?

The frequency of changing an amalgam separator in a dental office typically depends on the specific
model of the separator, its capacity, the volume of dental procedures performed, and the regulations
or guidelines set forth by local or regional authorities.

In general, most manufacturers recommend replacing or servicing amalgam separators regularly, often
every 6 to 12 months. Some separators have a stated capacity in terms of the volume of waste they
can handle before requiring replacement. This can range from a certain number of procedures or a
certain volume of waste collected.

Furthermore, local regulations or guidelines might specify the maintenance schedule or replacement
intervals for amalgam separators. It’s important to adhere to these regulations to ensure compliance
with environmental standards and best practices for managing dental waste, including the disposal of
dental amalgam.

Regular maintenance, such as inspections and replacing the separator cartridges or units as
recommended by the manufacturer, is crucial to ensure the effective removal of dental amalgam waste
and prevent its release into the environment.

Dental offices should keep track of the usage and maintenance schedule of their amalgam separators
to ensure they are changed or serviced at the appropriate intervals for efficient operation and
compliance with regulations.

# Dental wastewater products built for simple compliance.

Shop AQ-Solution line cleaner products and amalgam recycling containers for safe, effective dental
wastewater management.

[ Shop Products ][13] [ View Featured ][14]

Environmentally Responsible Dental Wastewater Solutions

## Protecting water while making compliance easier for dental offices.

Anterior Quest is committed to providing environmentally friendly and healthy evacuation system
solutions. Our award-winning HG Containment System is designed to capture dental wastewater, help
eliminate mercury from entering the wastewater stream, and reduce the burden placed on dental office
staff.

Unlike traditional separator systems that require staff to handle filters and waste materials,
Anterior Quest provides a hands-off service. Our team removes collected amalgam waste, transports it
to a centralized treatment facility, and processes it through a controlled treatment system.
[ Contact US ][15] [ Learn More ][16]
🌊

### Water Preservation

Designed to help keep dental mercury out of the wastewater stream and protect one of our most
valuable resources.


✅

### Simple Compliance

Helps dental practices manage wastewater responsibly while reducing internal handling and
maintenance concerns.

🦷

### Hands-Off Service

Our staff handles removal, transport, treatment, and support so your team can stay focused on
patient care.

How It Works

## A cleaner process from collection to treatment.

Anterior Quest gives dental offices a managed solution for collecting, transporting, and treating
amalgam waste without disrupting daily operations.

### Containment

A patented, maintenance-free amalgam containment system that captures and safely manages dental
mercury and amalgam waste.

[ Learn More ][17]

### Collection

Our staff arrives at the dental office and removes collected amalgam waste from the containment
system.

### Transport

Waste is transported by Anterior Quest to a centralized treatment facility without contact from
office staff.

### Treatment

Wastewater is processed, tested, and treated to help ensure only clean water is released back into
the system.

Environmental Impact

## 909,000

Acres of lake protected from mercury contamination

Since 2013, Anterior Quest has helped recycle dental wastewater and prevent mercury from entering
the environment, preserving millions of acres of freshwater for future generations.

Gallons Recycled

# Dental wastewater products built for simple compliance.

Shop AQ-Solution line cleaner products and amalgam recycling containers for safe, effective dental
wastewater management.

[ Shop Products ][13] [ View Featured ][14]

Environmentally Responsible Dental Wastewater Solutions

## Protecting water while making compliance easier for dental offices.

Anterior Quest is committed to providing environmentally friendly and healthy evacuation system
solutions. Our award-winning HG Containment System is designed to capture dental wastewater, help
eliminate mercury from entering the wastewater stream, and reduce the burden placed on dental office
staff.

Unlike traditional separator systems that require staff to handle filters and waste materials,
Anterior Quest provides a hands-off service. Our team removes collected amalgam waste, transports it
to a centralized treatment facility, and processes it through a controlled treatment system.
[ Contact US ][15] [ Learn More ][16]
🌊

### Water Preservation

Designed to help keep dental mercury out of the wastewater stream and protect one of our most
valuable resources.


✅

### Simple Compliance

Helps dental practices manage wastewater responsibly while reducing internal handling and
maintenance concerns.

🦷

### Hands-Off Service

Our staff handles removal, transport, treatment, and support so your team can stay focused on
patient care.

How It Works

## A cleaner process from collection to treatment.

Anterior Quest gives dental offices a managed solution for collecting, transporting, and treating
amalgam waste without disrupting daily operations.

### Containment

A patented, maintenance-free amalgam containment system that captures and safely manages dental
mercury and amalgam waste.

[ Learn More ][17]

### Collection

Our staff arrives at the dental office and removes collected amalgam waste from the containment
system.

### Transport

Waste is transported by Anterior Quest to a centralized treatment facility without contact from
office staff.

### Treatment

Wastewater is processed, tested, and treated to help ensure only clean water is released back into
the system.

Environmental Impact

## 909,000

Acres of lake protected from mercury contamination

Since 2013, Anterior Quest has helped recycle dental wastewater and prevent mercury from entering
the environment, preserving millions of acres of freshwater for future generations.

230,000+

Gallons Recycled

100%

Since 2013

## Your smile, our experts.

Your best smile is waiting at Bright Now! Dental! From cleanings to crowns, whitening to wisdom
teeth, we’ve got you covered with the comprehensive dental services you and your family need for a
lifetime of good oral health.
At Bright Now! Dental, you and your family can receive all the care you need at one convenient
location, saving you time, money, and hassle. We have all the state-of-the-art equipment and
technology to perform many procedures in-office as well as the experienced and highly-trained staff
to do them, making Bright Now! Dental a truly full-service provider.

## Bright Now! Dental is your affordable, comprehensive dental provider.

Good dental health is essential for good overall health, and at Bright Now! Dental, we care about
both! We offer all the dental and oral care services you need to get—and keep—your smile healthy.

Bright Now! Dental knows that taking care of your teeth takes a team effort. From the doctors to the
schedulers, from the front desk to the back billing, we’re all here to make sure your experience is
as seamless and stress-free as possible. We also understand that no two situations are the same, so
you can be confident that you’ll receive personalized, attentive, and considerate customer service,
no matter what your circumstances.

What makes Bright Now! Dental different is our commitment to high quality, affordable care for every
patient. Not only can we provide greater flexibility in service pricing for our patients, we can
also provide the time, technology, and resources our dentists need to deliver the individualized
care you deserve in a familiar, convenient, and comfortable setting.

### Right Here, Right Now

#### Open Evenings & Weekends

##### Here when you need us. Your neighborhood dentist.

Bright Now! Dental is here for you no matter when you need us or what you need us for. We know that
you’re busy, and sometimes you just can’t fit routine dental care into your 9-5 schedule. That’s why
we’re open on weekends and evenings at easy-to-find retail locations right in your neighborhood, so
you can get in, get out, and get on with your day without sacrificing quality care*.

[Read More][71]

We also provide exceptional emergency dental care services for dental emergencies and urgent dental
injuries. Bright Now! Dental accepts call-ahead and walk-in emergencies and we can see most patients
same-day.

Bright Now! Dental has more than 90 affiliated locations throughout Arizona, California, Colorado,
Florida, Indiana, Maryland, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Virginia, and Washington, which means there
is one near you! Find your closest one here.

*individual office hours vary.

## Your smile, our experts.

Your best smile is waiting at Bright Now! Dental! From cleanings to crowns, whitening to wisdom
teeth, we’ve got you covered with the comprehensive dental services you and your family need for a
lifetime of good oral health.
At Bright Now! Dental, you and your family can receive all the care you need at one convenient
location, saving you time, money, and hassle. We have all the state-of-the-art equipment and
technology to perform many procedures in-office as well as the experienced and highly-trained staff
to do them, making Bright Now! Dental a truly full-service provider.

## Bright Now! Dental is your affordable, comprehensive dental provider.

Good dental health is essential for good overall health, and at Bright Now! Dental, we care about
both! We offer all the dental and oral care services you need to get—and keep—your smile healthy.

Bright Now! Dental knows that taking care of your teeth takes a team effort. From the doctors to the
schedulers, from the front desk to the back billing, we’re all here to make sure your experience is
as seamless and stress-free as possible. We also understand that no two situations are the same, so
you can be confident that you’ll receive personalized, attentive, and considerate customer service,
no matter what your circumstances.

What makes Bright Now! Dental different is our commitment to high quality, affordable care for every
patient. Not only can we provide greater flexibility in service pricing for our patients, we can
also provide the time, technology, and resources our dentists need to deliver the individualized
care you deserve in a familiar, convenient, and comfortable setting.

#### Open Evenings & Weekends

##### Here when you need us. Your neighborhood dentist.

Bright Now! Dental is here for you no matter when you need us or what you need us for. We know that
you’re busy, and sometimes you just can’t fit routine dental care into your 9-5 schedule. That’s why
we’re open on weekends and evenings at easy-to-find retail locations right in your neighborhood, so
you can get in, get out, and get on with your day without sacrificing quality care*.

[Read More][71]

We also provide exceptional emergency dental care services for dental emergencies and urgent dental
injuries. Bright Now! Dental accepts call-ahead and walk-in emergencies and we can see most patients
same-day.

Bright Now! Dental has more than 90 affiliated locations throughout Arizona, California, Colorado,
Florida, Indiana, Maryland, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Virginia, and Washington, which means there
is one near you! Find your closest one here.

#### Offers/Insurance/OneSmile Dental Plan/Financing

##### Dental Care that fits your budget.

At Bright Now! Dental, we’re proud to offer exceptional dental care that fits your schedule and your
budget. We believe that getting and keeping a beautiful, healthy smile shouldn’t be expensive, and
with our cost-saving special offers like new patient specials, affordable prices, and low-interest

we accept, we also offer our own OneSmile Dental Plan, which provides members with $20 exams, no
cost x-rays, and 20-40% off most other dental services for one low annual fee.

[Read More][74]

Bright Now! Dental is passionate about patient care, and our goal is to give you the best from the
minute you walk in our doors. We welcome patients of all abilities and all financial means,
providing ASL interpreters, disability accommodations, auxiliary aids, and policy, price, and
practice modifications wherever necessary to ensure every single patient gets the quality care and
services they deserve.

We also work hard to create a safe and healthy environment for our staff and patients. We adhere to
the strictest safety protocols to protect ourselves and our patients from infection and do not
deviate from those for patients who are unwilling to cooperate. We’ve also implemented heightened
cleaning and safety standards to make sure our equipment and facilities exceed your expectations.

### DDShgSolutions

We are a U.S. manufacturer committed to delivering the highest quality amalgam separators and
composite organizers at the most affordable cost to the dental industry.

**The Simple One^{®}** chairside amalgam separator saves dentists money!  It is a fraction of the
cost of a central system and is manufactured in the U.S.A.

**Comp-Caddie™** allows for organization of composite types and shades, and conveniently holds two
dispensers on top of the unit. Its design is an attractive addition to any dental office.

DDShgSolutions is a family owned and operated business. Our goal is to be one of the world’s leading
producers and providers of high quality U.S. made dental materials. We are 100% committed to
customer service while offering products at affordable prices.

Our amalgam separation process is the easiest in the industry! We can confidently say, The Simple
One^{®} will save you money on filter and labor costs throughout the maintenance and recycling
process. We recommend changing out the filter annually.

This product is ISO 11143:2008 Certified for 96% and 99% efficiency.

**Become environmentally compliant today with The Simple One^{®} Chairside Amalgam Separator.**

interface ensures effortless navigation, allowing you to quickly locate and review SDS information
with just a few clicks. Experience peace of mind knowing that essential safety information is
readily available at your fingertips, empowering you to make informed decisions and maintain a safe
working environment.

automatically generates Continuing Education (CE) certificates, securely stored in individual staff

[ [Your Everyday Decisions Are More Important Than You Realize] ][91]

###### [Your Everyday Decisions Are More Important Than You Realize][92]

**Swab Test Case Study**

I was asked to perform an informal case study on dental office evacuation valves. This was a
challenge in many ways. Several offices I contacted were leery to allow swab testing in their
offices even though they said they felt confident of their disinfection process. My infection
control flag went up many times in those practices. If they felt confident, why are they leery of
doing a simple swab test? What was the risk to them? One office wanted to check with his lawyer,
wanted my license, and much more seeming ridiculous information. The offices that were welcoming
wanted to know how they could improve their infection prevention protocol. A big benefit was they
received bags of disposable valves for allowing testing of their disinfected valves.

Testing was done to determine if the valves were contaminated even after disinfection. What are the
consequences of the unknown invisible organic matter? What pathogens are nesting here? When
disinfected what pathogens are being reduced or present?

As an experienced infection prevention and safety specialist, I performed the swab-testing. After
reviewing the results, I was glad I had donned the appropriate PPE. Yet maybe I should have worn a
hazmat suit!

**The Down and Dirty Results**

I processed 212 valve surfaces and determined they were ***YES ***contaminated after a routine
disinfecting protocol. Discovering the bacterial load on dental unit vacuum valves left me with an
uneasy feeling. Are we creating a healthy environment for our patients? Occupational Safety, Asepsis
and Prevention (OSAP) has repeatedly stated that dental patients should be in a safe dental
environment which includes the entire dental facility and all the processes.

Just to begin to discover where problems happen, the first question should be if the valves were
disinfected according to manufacturer’s instructions? Metal valve companies recommend routine
disassembly, scrubbing and reprocessing of the surfaces between patients. Minimal industry standard
between patient protocol should be to:
* Wipe once to clean
* Wipe a second time to disinfect

**Saliva ejector and Backflow Risks**

It’s not new information that back flow from low-volume saliva ejectors is happening. Research has
shown that when a patient seals their lips around the tip of the salvia ejector, backflow can occur
via the pressure created in the patient’s mouth. Studies report that gravity pulls fluid back toward
patient’s mouth when tube positioning is above the patient’s mouth or when both high or low suction
is used at the same time. Unfortunately, like not going in the water for 30 minutes after eating
myth, we have taught our patients to close their lips around the saliva ejector.

The CDC recommends that the dental community advise their patients not to close their lips around
the saliva ejector. CDC concluded that research confirms the significant risk in backflow with
microbial cross contamination between patients.

Is your office using old, outdated operating procedures that are as myth based as watermelon seeds
germinating in your stomach? Updated written policies and procedures are a must for any dental
setting. Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) can be used for training and OSHA safety purposes.
These policies should be reviewed on an annual basis. Check lists are powerful reminders of what
might be forgotten in daily routines. (Go to [http://www.oshatrainingbootcamp.com][93] to find
checklists and more.)

**Replace the Old with the New**

Replacing an old car with a new car increases safety with airbags, hands free phone connection and
camera’s in the rear panel to prevent from hitting a child or running over a bicycle. The prevention
is worth every penny. Valves are now available to keep patient’s safe in any dental facility. New
disposable versions are clean and offer backflow prevention. We need to protect our patients from
microbial biohazardous debris and possible transmission of disease via backwash. The Hippocratic
Oath and professional ethics standards demand that we first, do no harm.

**About the Author**

Mrs. Pat Pine, RDH is a national and international speaker specializing in OSHA, infection control,
lasers and orofacial myology. She brings thirty years of experience in dentistry to provide exciting
and evidenced based programs. Pat believes that safety, infection control, and whole health are
important to providers and patients alike. Her philosophy is an empowered team is a healthy team,
which in turn creates an unstoppable referral formula. Ms. Pine conducts in-office trainings, boot
camps, online seminars, and dental/dental hygiene conventions. She is a member of OSAP
speaker's/consultant's bureau and publishes regularly in several dental magazines. Pat reminds
others that education doesn't stop at clinical treatment. It is an on-going process to enrich
ones-self and bring the highest quality of care to patients. Pat can be reached at
info@oshatrainingbootcamp.com

**The new AERO HVE/SE combo reduces airborne aerosol movement by up to 95 percent**

DOVE® Dental Products announces the release of the new DOVE® AERO, a single-use hybrid device
designed to significantly reduce the risk of airborne aerosol movement caused by instrument use in a
dental setting.

The threat from COVID-19 has prompted oral health professionals to rethink their infectious disease
protocol to mitigate the spread of contagions in three areas: evacuation, backflow, and aerosol
management. With the introduction of the new AERO product, DOVE Dental Products is leading the
charge. To date, no device on the market addresses all three concerns without sacrificing patient
comfort or altering dental practices. According to the Guidance for Dental Settings published by the
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), “…if aerosol-generating procedures are necessary
for dental care, use four-handed dentistry, high evacuation suction and dental dams to minimize
droplet spatter and aerosols.”

###### [Your Everyday Decisions Are More Important Than You Realize][92]

**Swab Test Case Study**

I was asked to perform an informal case study on dental office evacuation valves. This was a
challenge in many ways. Several offices I contacted were leery to allow swab testing in their
offices even though they said they felt confident of their disinfection process. My infection
control flag went up many times in those practices. If they felt confident, why are they leery of
doing a simple swab test? What was the risk to them? One office wanted to check with his lawyer,
wanted my license, and much more seeming ridiculous information. The offices that were welcoming
wanted to know how they could improve their infection prevention protocol. A big benefit was they
received bags of disposable valves for allowing testing of their disinfected valves.

Testing was done to determine if the valves were contaminated even after disinfection. What are the
consequences of the unknown invisible organic matter? What pathogens are nesting here? When
disinfected what pathogens are being reduced or present?

As an experienced infection prevention and safety specialist, I performed the swab-testing. After
reviewing the results, I was glad I had donned the appropriate PPE. Yet maybe I should have worn a
hazmat suit!

**The Down and Dirty Results**

I processed 212 valve surfaces and determined they were ***YES ***contaminated after a routine
disinfecting protocol. Discovering the bacterial load on dental unit vacuum valves left me with an
uneasy feeling. Are we creating a healthy environment for our patients? Occupational Safety, Asepsis
and Prevention (OSAP) has repeatedly stated that dental patients should be in a safe dental
environment which includes the entire dental facility and all the processes.

Just to begin to discover where problems happen, the first question should be if the valves were
disinfected according to manufacturer’s instructions? Metal valve companies recommend routine
disassembly, scrubbing and reprocessing of the surfaces between patients. Minimal industry standard
between patient protocol should be to:
* Wipe once to clean
* Wipe a second time to disinfect

**Saliva ejector and Backflow Risks**

It’s not new information that back flow from low-volume saliva ejectors is happening. Research has
shown that when a patient seals their lips around the tip of the salvia ejector, backflow can occur
via the pressure created in the patient’s mouth. Studies report that gravity pulls fluid back toward
patient’s mouth when tube positioning is above the patient’s mouth or when both high or low suction
is used at the same time. Unfortunately, like not going in the water for 30 minutes after eating
myth, we have taught our patients to close their lips around the saliva ejector.

The CDC recommends that the dental community advise their patients not to close their lips around
the saliva ejector. CDC concluded that research confirms the significant risk in backflow with
microbial cross contamination between patients.

Is your office using old, outdated operating procedures that are as myth based as watermelon seeds
germinating in your stomach? Updated written policies and procedures are a must for any dental
setting. Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) can be used for training and OSHA safety purposes.
These policies should be reviewed on an annual basis. Check lists are powerful reminders of what
might be forgotten in daily routines. (Go to [http://www.oshatrainingbootcamp.com][93] to find
checklists and more.)

**Replace the Old with the New**

Replacing an old car with a new car increases safety with airbags, hands free phone connection and
camera’s in the rear panel to prevent from hitting a child or running over a bicycle. The prevention
is worth every penny. Valves are now available to keep patient’s safe in any dental facility. New
disposable versions are clean and offer backflow prevention. We need to protect our patients from
microbial biohazardous debris and possible transmission of disease via backwash. The Hippocratic
Oath and professional ethics standards demand that we first, do no harm.

**About the Author**

Mrs. Pat Pine, RDH is a national and international speaker specializing in OSHA, infection control,
lasers and orofacial myology. She brings thirty years of experience in dentistry to provide exciting
and evidenced based programs. Pat believes that safety, infection control, and whole health are
important to providers and patients alike. Her philosophy is an empowered team is a healthy team,
which in turn creates an unstoppable referral formula. Ms. Pine conducts in-office trainings, boot
camps, online seminars, and dental/dental hygiene conventions. She is a member of OSAP
speaker's/consultant's bureau and publishes regularly in several dental magazines. Pat reminds
others that education doesn't stop at clinical treatment. It is an on-going process to enrich
ones-self and bring the highest quality of care to patients. Pat can be reached at
info@oshatrainingbootcamp.com

## Dental Amalgam Compliance and Regulations

Amalgam Separators and Cartridges

DRNA's Amalgam Separators and its line of Generic Cartridges satisfy all local, state, and federal
regulations for amalgam disposal and recycling. Furthermore, the DRNA Generic 1 cartridge was
successfully tested using the Solmetex® Hg5® (Legacy) Amalgam Separator unit and met the ISO
11143:2008 standard.
* DRNA Generic Cartridge 1 is compatible with the Solmetex® Hg5® (Legacy) Amalgam Separator unit.
* EPA regulation requires cartridge replacement every year or once sediment reaches the fill line,
  whichever occurs sooner.
* DRNA makes replacement easy and hassle-free with on demand pick-up, recycling, and documentation
  included!

Scrap Amalgam Handling, Collection and Recycling

DRNA’s all-inclusive amalgam recycling service ensures that your office is able to effectively
manage all materials that fall under the category of “scrap amalgam.”
* Amalgam recycling kits come in 1.25 gallon, 2.5 gallon, or 5 gallon sizes.
* Amalgam Recycling Mail-back kit includes prepaid return label and all requisite compliance
  documentation.
* All amalgam wastes are recycled at an EPA-certified facility here in the United States.

Monitoring, Reporting and Record Keeping

All of DRNA’s products and services are supported by clear and accurate monitoring, reporting, and
record keeping in order to establish and evidence compliance. Dedicated monitoring and enforcement
is conducted by publicly owned treatment works (POTWs), local to your establishment.
* Adherence to all BMP’s and recycling of all scrap amalgam.
* Canisters, cartridges, or separator units are recycled in a timely manner, per manufacturer’s
  requirements

# Dental Recycling Solutions

Providing Dental Recycling
and Compliance Solutions that are Cost-Effective
and Support Sustainable Development Practices

[Start Saving Today][27]

Recycling &

Cost Effective

Supporting the
Dental Industry

Why DRNA?

As a leading provider in North America of dental waste management and recycling, including amalgam
wastes, x-ray chemistry, lead, bio-hazardous and pharmaceutical wastes, DRNA offers cost-effective
solutions that save dentists money, while keeping everyone compliant. Whether you need equipment,
recycling services, documentation or education, the DRNA team is eager to support your business,
budget, and bottom line.

 
* DRNA is a leading, direct-to-dentist, provider of dental waste management and recycling in North
  America
* Compliance ensured
* Cost-effective savings
* Solutions delivered direct to dentists

Trusted by...

Supported by 60,000 dentists representing dental associations and dental insurance companies, DRNA
represents comprehensive regulatory solutions for the dental community, including dentists just like
you.

"Kerr is highly committed to the environment and pleased to support DRNA’s mission to see that the
environmental aspects of amalgam are addressed in the most satisfactory manner.

Given the upcoming EPA federal rule on amalgam recycling, we are keen to do our part to educate the
dental profession on the best solutions in place to address this important environmental compliance
issue."

[Kerr logo]
**Todd Norbe**
President for Kerr Corporation,
North America

## Dental Amalgam Compliance and Regulations

Amalgam Separators and Cartridges

DRNA's Amalgam Separators and its line of Generic Cartridges satisfy all local, state, and federal
regulations for amalgam disposal and recycling. Furthermore, the DRNA Generic 1 cartridge was
successfully tested using the Solmetex® Hg5® (Legacy) Amalgam Separator unit and met the ISO
11143:2008 standard.
* DRNA Generic Cartridge 1 is compatible with the Solmetex® Hg5® (Legacy) Amalgam Separator unit.
* EPA regulation requires cartridge replacement every year or once sediment reaches the fill line,
  whichever occurs sooner.
* DRNA makes replacement easy and hassle-free with on demand pick-up, recycling, and documentation
  included!

Scrap Amalgam Handling, Collection and Recycling

DRNA’s all-inclusive amalgam recycling service ensures that your office is able to effectively
manage all materials that fall under the category of “scrap amalgam.”
* Amalgam recycling kits come in 1.25 gallon, 2.5 gallon, or 5 gallon sizes.
* Amalgam Recycling Mail-back kit includes prepaid return label and all requisite compliance
  documentation.
* All amalgam wastes are recycled at an EPA-certified facility here in the United States.

Monitoring, Reporting and Record Keeping

All of DRNA’s products and services are supported by clear and accurate monitoring, reporting, and
record keeping in order to establish and evidence compliance. Dedicated monitoring and enforcement
is conducted by publicly owned treatment works (POTWs), local to your establishment.
* Adherence to all BMP’s and recycling of all scrap amalgam.
* Canisters, cartridges, or separator units are recycled in a timely manner, per manufacturer’s
  requirements

# Sustainable waste management services for every business

Evirum delivers eco-friendly and cost-effective waste solutions, helping you manage residual
materials with ease while prioritizing environmental responsibility.

[Get a Quote][4] [Free Assessment][5]
[evirum-garbage-truck-downtown]
Trusted by leading businesses across North America

## Partnering with industry leaders for sustainable solutions

From small enterprises to major corporations, Evirum is the go-to name in eco-responsible waste
management.

[Provigo-logo]
[Radisoon-logo]
[sail-logo]
[Mercedes-benz-logo]
[Nascar-logo]
[Keller-williams-logo]
[Tim-hortons-logo]
[Mcdonalds-logo]
[Couche-tard-logo]
[Iga-logo]

[Cogir-logo]
Explore our services

## Smarter solutions for a cleaner future

Experience tailored waste management services designed to simplify commercial waste disposal,
improve recycling efficiency, and reduce costs while supporting your sustainability goals. 

## Tailored waste solutions

Evirum delivers reliable, customized waste collection services tailored to your needs. Using 
equipment such as front-loading bins, rear-loading containers, roll-on bins, rear-loading
containers, roll-off bins, and semi-buried containers – we ensure efficient and dependable
collection of non-recyclable and non-compostable materials. Our team of green experts will recommend
the best solutions based on your materials, volume, and bin placement at your locations.

[Explore Waste Collection Services][6]

## Eco-friendly recycling

Transform materials like cardboard, paper, glass, and metals into valuable resources while keeping
them out of landfills and enhancing the material’s lifecycle. Designed for convenience, sorting bins
streamline the recycling process across offices, industrial facilities, retail spaces, and other
sectors, reducing environmental footprint and contamination of recycled materials all while helping
your business achieve its sustainability goals.

[Explore Corporate Recycling][7]

## Composting made simple

Turn food scraps and organic waste into nutrient-rich compost, reducing greenhouse gas emissions and
promoting a healthier planet. We provide sorting bins for easy separation of organic materials,
along with wheeled bins and front-load containers for efficient collection. Our pick-up services
ensure your organic waste is properly handled and processed.

[Explore Compost Solutions][8]
[garbage-bag]
[recycle-symbol]
[food-cycler-compost]
Overcome key waste management challenges

## Why Evirum?

Tired of missed pickups, confusing contracts, and endless rate comparisons? Leverage innovative
technology to personalize your waste management experience. We streamline the process, so you can
focus on your core business.

[hourglass-icon]

### Save time comparing providers

Stop wasting time evaluating endless options. Simplify decision-making and access the best waste
management solutions without the hassle.

[robot-icon]

### Say goodbye to poor customer experience

Gain peace of mind with reliable service, a digitized customer experience and timely issue
resolution. Spend less time chasing answers and more time focusing on your business operations.

[laws-icon]

### Stay ahead of changing laws

Navigate complex regulations effortlessly and avoid penalties. Be prepared for future changes such
as mandatory composting rules while reducing stress and ensuring compliance.

[regulations-icon]

### Regain control over confusing contracts

Ensure the terms and conditions of your waste service contracts are fair and transparent. Avoid
unexpected rate increases, auto-renewals, and cancellation penalties.

[digital-icon]

### Bridge the digital gap

Leverage innovative technology to streamline your waste management. Our digital tools ensure
transparent tracking, simplified scheduling, and a digitized customer experience.

DRIVEN BY SUSTAINABILITY

## Evirum teams up with NASCAR Canada for a greener future

As the official waste management partner of NASCAR Canada, Evirum is proud to bring eco-responsible
practices to the fast-paced world of motorsports. Together, we’re racing toward a sustainable
tomorrow.

[evirum-nascar]
[event-waste-diversion-report]
Green Impact Events

## Make your next event more sustainable

Minimize your event’s environmental impact with improved recycling systems, on-site waste sorting
solutions, and attendee education. Post-event diversion reports will provide insights into your
progress toward zero-waste.

[Green Impact Events][9]
[woman-smiling]
Building a Sustainable Legacy

## Champion sustainability with smarter waste solutions

Adopt eco-responsible waste management for events and business operations, from efficient sorting
systems to compliance support, tackle challenges like waste diversion and achieve impactful,
measurable sustainability goals.

[Get in Touch]

# Sustainable waste management services for every business

Evirum delivers eco-friendly and cost-effective waste solutions, helping you manage residual
materials with ease while prioritizing environmental responsibility.

[Get a Quote][4] [Free Assessment][5]
[evirum-garbage-truck-downtown]
Trusted by leading businesses across North America

## Partnering with industry leaders for sustainable solutions

From small enterprises to major corporations, Evirum is the go-to name in eco-responsible waste
management.

[Provigo-logo]
[Radisoon-logo]
[sail-logo]
[Mercedes-benz-logo]
[Nascar-logo]
[Keller-williams-logo]
[Tim-hortons-logo]
[Mcdonalds-logo]
[Couche-tard-logo]
[Iga-logo]
[Airbus-logo]
[Wr-meadows-logo]
[Cogir-logo]
Explore our services

## Smarter solutions for a cleaner future

Experience tailored waste management services designed to simplify commercial waste disposal,
improve recycling efficiency, and reduce costs while supporting your sustainability goals. 

## Tailored waste solutions

Evirum delivers reliable, customized waste collection services tailored to your needs. Using 
equipment such as front-loading bins, rear-loading containers, roll-on bins, rear-loading
containers, roll-off bins, and semi-buried containers – we ensure efficient and dependable
collection of non-recyclable and non-compostable materials. Our team of green experts will recommend
the best solutions based on your materials, volume, and bin placement at your locations.

[Explore Waste Collection Services][6]

## Eco-friendly recycling

Transform materials like cardboard, paper, glass, and metals into valuable resources while keeping
them out of landfills and enhancing the material’s lifecycle. Designed for convenience, sorting bins
streamline the recycling process across offices, industrial facilities, retail spaces, and other
sectors, reducing environmental footprint and contamination of recycled materials all while helping
your business achieve its sustainability goals.

[Explore Corporate Recycling][7]

## Composting made simple

Turn food scraps and organic waste into nutrient-rich compost, reducing greenhouse gas emissions and
promoting a healthier planet. We provide sorting bins for easy separation of organic materials,
along with wheeled bins and front-load containers for efficient collection. Our pick-up services
ensure your organic waste is properly handled and processed.

[Explore Compost Solutions][8]
[garbage-bag]
[recycle-symbol]
[food-cycler-compost]
Overcome key waste management challenges

## Why Evirum?

Tired of missed pickups, confusing contracts, and endless rate comparisons? Leverage innovative
technology to personalize your waste management experience. We streamline the process, so you can
focus on your core business.

[hourglass-icon]

### Save time comparing providers

Stop wasting time evaluating endless options. Simplify decision-making and access the best waste
management solutions without the hassle.

[robot-icon]

### Say goodbye to poor customer experience

Gain peace of mind with reliable service, a digitized customer experience and timely issue
resolution. Spend less time chasing answers and more time focusing on your business operations.

[laws-icon]

### Stay ahead of changing laws

Navigate complex regulations effortlessly and avoid penalties. Be prepared for future changes such
as mandatory composting rules while reducing stress and ensuring compliance.

[regulations-icon]

### Regain control over confusing contracts

Ensure the terms and conditions of your waste service contracts are fair and transparent. Avoid
unexpected rate increases, auto-renewals, and cancellation penalties.

[digital-icon]

### Bridge the digital gap

Leverage innovative technology to streamline your waste management. Our digital tools ensure
transparent tracking, simplified scheduling, and a digitized customer experience.

DRIVEN BY SUSTAINABILITY

## Evirum teams up with NASCAR Canada for a greener future

As the official waste management partner of NASCAR Canada, Evirum is proud to bring eco-responsible
practices to the fast-paced world of motorsports. Together, we’re racing toward a sustainable
tomorrow.

[evirum-nascar]
[event-waste-diversion-report]
Green Impact Events

## Make your next event more sustainable

Minimize your event’s environmental impact with improved recycling systems, on-site waste sorting
solutions, and attendee education. Post-event diversion reports will provide insights into your
progress toward zero-waste.

[Green Impact Events][9]
[woman-smiling]
Building a Sustainable Legacy

## Champion sustainability with smarter waste solutions

Adopt eco-responsible waste management for events and business operations, from efficient sorting
systems to compliance support, tackle challenges like waste diversion and achieve impactful,
measurable sustainability goals.

[Get in Touch]

Unser Unternehmen ist vom** 27.07.2026** **bis einschließlich 07.08.2026** aufgrund unseres
jährlichen Betriebsurlaubs **geschlossen**.

Während unseres Betriebsurlaubs können **keine Aufträge bearbeitet** bzw. **geliefert** werden.

## Mit Know-how und Leidenschaft immer wieder neue Lösungen für die moderne Zahnarztpraxis finden.

Mit der gesamten Produktpalette von METASYS, beginnend bei den Dentalgeräten und Hygieneprodukten
bis hin zur Sammlung, Trennung und dem Recycling von giftigen Abfällen und der Wiederverwertung von
Metallen aus Dentalpraxen, ist METASYS eines der wenigen Unternehmen weltweit, die den gesamten
Dental-Environment-Kreislauf aus einer Hand abdecken können.

bis 12° dH nahezu vollständig und reduziert sie selbst bei 20° dH deutlich. Damit steigert das
Produkt die Betriebssicherheit von Dentaleinheiten, schützt Leitungen und senkt den Wartungsaufwand.
[Erfahren Sie mehr.][106]

## [Entdecken Sie META Sense!][107]

Der neue Chemiesensor META Sense im WEK-System misst täglich mehrfach die
Wasserstoffperoxid-Konzentration im Brauchwasser. Bei Abweichungen passt das System automatisch nach
– für konstante Hygienesicherheit. Alle Messwerte werden protokolliert, bis zu ein Jahr gespeichert
und können über die METASYS Software ausgewertet werden. Erfahren Sie mehr in unserem Video

## Frequently Asked Questions

How do I find the right hospital abroad?

Use our hospital directory to browse JCI-accredited hospitals by country, specialty, or procedure.
Compare ratings, read patient reviews, and request free quotes directly from the hospital's
international patient department.

How much can I save on medical treatment abroad?

Patients typically save 40–80% compared to prices in the US, UK, or Australia. For example, a heart
bypass costing $45,000 in the US may cost $5,000–$8,000 in India or Thailand, with comparable
quality at internationally accredited hospitals.

Is the medical information on MyMedicPlus trustworthy?

Yes. All medical content is written by experienced health writers and reviewed by qualified medical
professionals. Every page shows the last updated date and the reviewing doctor's credentials. We
follow strict editorial guidelines and cite all sources.

Are the health calculators accurate?

Our health tools use validated, peer-reviewed formulas (WHO, AHA, etc.). They provide estimates for
educational purposes and are not a substitute for professional medical assessment. Always consult a
healthcare provider for personalized advice.

How do I get started with medical tourism?

Start by browsing our country guides to understand costs and visa requirements. Contact hospitals
directly through our platform for free quotes and video consultations. Our step-by-step medical
tourism planning guide walks you through every stage of the journey.

## Ready to make confident healthcare decisions?

Whether you're researching a condition, comparing treatment costs abroad, or looking for the right
hospital — MyMedicPlus is here to guide you, every step of the way.

professionals. Every page shows the last updated date and the reviewing doctor's credentials. We

educational purposes and are not a substitute for professional medical assessment. Always consult a

80% Reduction in Staff Time on Payer Calls

### Your Revenue Cycle, Running on Autopilot.

OSP's Agentic AI Revenue Engine automates the most repetitive task in your billing workflow —
calling payers to check claim status. It makes the calls, captures the updates, and reports
everything in real time, so your team spends zero time on hold.

#### What It Does:
* Automatically calls payers to check claim status
* Captures claim updates without any manual follow-up
* Logs and reports claim status directly to an Excel sheet
* Replaces hours of staff time spent on hold with payers

[ See It In Action ][113]
[RCM Revenue Engine Dashboard]
4x Faster Denial Resolution with AI
5x Reduction in Denial Management Workload

### Stop Writing Off Denied Claims. Start Recovering Them.

OSP's RCM Revenue Engine pulls denied claims from any source — EHR, clearinghouse, or manual upload
— uses AI to identify the root cause, determines the best course of action, and automates the entire
resolution workflow. From appeal letters to resubmissions to payer follow-up, it handles the work
your team never has time for.

#### What It Does
* Identifies root cause of every denial using AI
* Auto-generates appeal letters tailored to payer requirements
* Resubmits claims or routes complex cases to staff
* Tracks every denial from identification to resolution

[ See It In Action ][114]
[Claims Scrubbing Dashboard]
95%+ First-Pass Clean Claim Rate
50% Reduction in Manual Claim Review

### Every Claim Scrubbed Before It Leaves Your Office.

OSP's AI Claims Scrubbing Agent validates every claim before submission — checking coding accuracy,
payer rules, NCCI edits, and eligibility in real time. It catches the errors, suggests the fixes,
and routes clean claims to the payer, so your billing team never wastes time on preventable denials.

#### What It Does
* Automatically validates CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS codes against payer-specific rules
* Catches coding errors, missing modifiers, and bundling violations before submission
* Verifies patient eligibility, prior auth, and COB in real time
* Routes clean claims to payer and flags dirty claims with specific fix instructions

[ See It In Action ][115]

The challenge & the fix

## Running a dental clinic in Ontario is harder than it should be.

Compliance keeps shifting. Hiring is brutal. Your team is busy running the clinic - not managing
manuals. Prime DMS handles the parts of practice ownership that drain your time.

Without Prime DMS
* ### Inspection anxiety
  
  Public health visits feel like a moving target. Documentation is scattered, staff training is out
  of date, and corrective actions linger after every report.
* ### Hiring and turnover
  
  Hygienists and assistants are hard to find. Onboarding is inconsistent, contracts aren't
  standardized, and good people leave for clinics that feel more organized.
* ### Compliance overwhelm
  
  RCDSO, CDHO, Public Health Ontario, WHMIS, AODA, Ministry of Labour - keeping up with every
  standard pulls your team away from patient care.
With Prime DMS
* ### Audit-ready, every day
  
  On-site IPAC audits, written protocols, sterilization log templates, and biological-monitoring
  documentation - so an inspection is just a normal Tuesday.
* ### A pipeline of pre-screened talent
  
  RCDSO and CDHO licensing verified before you see a resume. Structured 30-60-90 day onboarding
  plans built around your clinic's culture.
* ### One partner for every standard
  
  Prime DMS keeps your clinic aligned with every Ontario regulator - and tracks renewals, manuals,
  and training records on your behalf.

Ready to move from inspection-anxiety to audit-ready?

## Amalgam Separators For Dental Practices Who Care About Quality

[ Shop Online ][17]

### Greater Capacity

We guarantee **ONE** filter change per year! We prioritize quality so you can focus on giving your
customers the best service.

have to worry about mishaps.

### competitors means only one collector change each year—GUARANTEED!

### Long-lasting, high-quality stainless steel

### Environmental

### Exceeds ISO 11143-2008 standards in waste removal efficiency

### Completely sealed; designed with safety in mind

### Durable: Requires no moving parts or electricity

### All waste is disposed of by our sister company, Pristine Environmental, in accordance with

# Solmetex. Dental water solutions simplified.

Our trusted brands – Solmetex®, Sterisil® and DryShield® – work together as a complete, easy-to-use
system for managing the water in, through and out of your dental practice. We’re the only solution
you need to ensure safety, compliance, and peace of mind every step of the way.

[Shop our products][103]
[A dental hygienist smiles confidently]

## My Solutions Center™

[My Solution Center Login][104]

Don’t have an account? [Register now][105].

### Recycling Labels & Certificates

Print your recycling shipping labels and access recycling certificates to maintain EPA Dental
Amalgam Rule compliance.

### Monitor Dental Office Waterlines

Keep your water clean and safe! Log and retrieve water test results online. Our log of mail-in and
in-office waterline test results make it easy.

### Automate Product Deliveries

Create and manage product subscriptions for your dental practice and have them shipped direct from
your preferred distributor!

## Safe, clean water for your dental practice and for the environment.

> Water safety is very important to us because what goes into the patient’s mouth has to be clean
> and safe.
> 
> What really impresses me about the Solmetex® System of Water Solutions is its versatility. With a
> range of proven products, I was able to **customize my water management system** to meet the
> unique needs of my practice. Whether I needed a simple chairside filtration unit or a more
> comprehensive central filtration system, Solmetex® had the perfect the solution for me.
> 
> – Alex Vasserman, DMD

## It’s not just your water – it’s your waterlines.

**Dental waterlines can grow harmful bacteria. That’s why we created FASTCheck15™. It’s the quickest
and most affordable way to test your water.**

In just 15 minutes, you’ll know if your water is safe. No hassle, no waiting—just simple peace of
mind for your practice.

[Request a sample][106]

# Solmetex. Dental water solutions simplified.

Our trusted brands – Solmetex®, Sterisil® and DryShield® – work together as a complete, easy-to-use
system for managing the water in, through and out of your dental practice. We’re the only solution
you need to ensure safety, compliance, and peace of mind every step of the way.

[Shop our products][103]
[A dental hygienist smiles confidently]

## My Solutions Center™

[My Solution Center Login][104]

Don’t have an account? [Register now][105].

### Recycling Labels & Certificates

Print your recycling shipping labels and access recycling certificates to maintain EPA Dental
Amalgam Rule compliance.

### Monitor Dental Office Waterlines

Keep your water clean and safe! Log and retrieve water test results online. Our log of mail-in and
in-office waterline test results make it easy.

### Automate Product Deliveries

Create and manage product subscriptions for your dental practice and have them shipped direct from
your preferred distributor!

## Safe, clean water for your dental practice and for the environment.

> Water safety is very important to us because what goes into the patient’s mouth has to be clean
> and safe.
> 
> What really impresses me about the Solmetex® System of Water Solutions is its versatility. With a
> range of proven products, I was able to **customize my water management system** to meet the
> unique needs of my practice. Whether I needed a simple chairside filtration unit or a more
> comprehensive central filtration system, Solmetex® had the perfect the solution for me.
> 
> – Alex Vasserman, DMD

## It’s not just your water – it’s your waterlines.

**Dental waterlines can grow harmful bacteria. That’s why we created FASTCheck15™. It’s the quickest
and most affordable way to test your water.**

In just 15 minutes, you’ll know if your water is safe. No hassle, no waiting—just simple peace of
mind for your practice.

[Request a sample][106]

#### Analytics and Modelling

#### Insight Development

#### Actionable Deliverables

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do

## Thematic and Disruption Research

Our Thematic & Disruption Research identifies the structural shifts, emerging technologies, new
business models, and macro forces reshaping industries. We decode early signals, model long-term
scenarios, and highlight opportunities and risks-equipping leaders with future-ready insight to
guide strategy, investment, innovation, and organizational resilience.

Deep dives on cross-cutting themes such as sustainability, digital transformation, AI, automation,
circular economy and new revenue models. We connect these themes back to specific industry and
segment opportunities.

[Read More about Thematic and Disruption Research][51]
[Thematic and Disruption Research]

## Strategic Revenue Advisory

Our Strategic Revenue Advisory helps organizations make confident, evidence-driven decisions about
where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,
customer behaviour, competitive context, and financial modelling to build a revenue strategy that is
resilient, high-impact, and aligned with long-term growth opportunities.

Support for decisions on where to play, how to win and how fast to move. This includes portfolio
focus, market entry, pricing, partnership strategy and capital allocation grounded in evidence.

[Read More about Strategic Revenue Advisory][52]
[Strategic Revenue Advisory]

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

### From Insight to Implementation

#### Data Collection

Structured gathering of market, customer, financial and competitive data from primary and secondary
sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

Use of quantitative models and AI supported analysis to reveal patterns, stress points and leading
indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

## Ready to turn market uncertainty into revenue clarity

Our consultants are ready to support your next strategy cycle, investment decision or market entry
initiative with clear, evidence based insight.

[Connect with Our Experts][53]

Our consultants are ready to help craft a future-focused, resilient, and innovative packaging
strategy tailored to your needs.

Connect with us through [www.strategicrevenueinsights.com][54] to discover how we can support your
packaging vision and operationalize your ambitions into tangible market impact.

# Toothe Is The Hassle-Free Way For Dental Practices To Simplify Compliance And Optimize Secure
# Communication.

[Toothe Website (3).png]

Our Total Compliance Solution provides 5 customized compliance manuals, quickstart guides, annual
review reminders, ongoing support plus a secure and compliant messaging platform with robust file
sharing and rock-solid verification.
 

Made by dentists for dentists, Toothe intimately understands your practice's compliance needs. We've
rolled everything into one streamlined solution so you can operate compliantly and efficiently.

[LEARN MORE ][16]

# Dental Compliance From Coast to Coast

[Toothe Website (9).png]

*Excludes Quebec

From coast to coast, Toothe understands the complexities of compliance for each province* and
territory in Canada. Your jurisdiction has its own unique regulatory requirements including
standards, guides, codes and bylaws from the College, provincial legislation and even federal
regulations.


Toothe's Total Compliance Solution is the first-of-its-kind system with an affordable and
all-inclusive compliance solution that covers every area of dental compliance. It is fully
customized to your office and jurisdiction, and gives you peace of mind with automatic monitoring
and updates for when regulations change in your area.


Toothe has done the heavy lifting for you, so you can focus on what matters most – your patients!

#### Your Hassle-Free Compliance Experience

The Toothe Software
* Industry-leading referral and communication platform
* Secure & encrypted messaging and file sharing
* Confirm when sent files are opened, giving you sender verification
* Easy to use with just a 30-minute onboarding session
* Ongoing support
   

The Compliance Manuals
* Tailored manuals for Privacy & Security, Infection Prevention & Control, Occupational Health &
  Safety, Radiation and Office Policies
* FREE Privacy Impact Assessment*
* Quick start guides
* Staff training resources
* Annual review checklists
* Ongoing support

The Hassle-Free Process

1. Fill out the quick & easy online questionnaires for your dental practice
2. We build your customized compliance manuals 
3. You receive your customized digital and printed manuals in the mail
4. Implement the simple quick start guide. Easy Peasy Lemon Squeezy!

*Get a FREE Privacy Impact Assessment with the purchase of the Total Compliance Solution for offices

month-to-month basis.

#### Your Total Compliance Solution

Toothe Secure Messenger seamlessly integrates all the essential tools you need to navigate daily
compliance operations with ease!

 

Additionally, our compliance manuals were meticulously curated by a dentist, ensuring that all the
essential elements needed for compliance are readily available.

 

TCS includes customized Privacy & Security Policies manual, Infection Prevention and Control manual
(IPC), Occupational Health & Safety manual (OHS), Radiation manual, Office Policy manual and a FREE
Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA)*.

 

Compliance has never been easier!

Ditch the phones and eliminate disruptions. Our flexible messaging suite keeps your entire workflow

* Person-to-Person

Share With Confidence
Quickly and securely share anything. No more compromised patient privacy.
* Referrals

Our exclusive Verification Center lets you instantly see when sent files are opened and by whom -
giving you proof of secure delivery and avoiding miscommunication.

Compliant, efficient, and intuitive communication is finally a reality with Toothe Secure Messenger.

**A legacy of coverage and care**

We believe in improving both oral health and overall health by making sure everyone has access to
high-quality dental insurance. Since our founding in 1955, we’ve been at the forefront of
progressive healthcare for all — supported by a strong network of dentists dedicated to delivering
preventive dental care.

⁴ 2024 Community Impact Report

Delta Dental PPO plans are underwritten by Delta Dental Insurance Company in AL, DC (Policy
IENT-P-CORE-DC-R25), FL, GA, LA, MS, MT, NV and UT and by not-for-profit dental service companies in
these states: CA — Delta Dental of California; PA, MD — Delta Dental of Pennsylvania; NY — Delta
Dental of New York, Inc.; DE — Delta Dental of Delaware, Inc.; WV — Delta Dental of West Virginia,
Inc. In Texas, Delta Dental Insurance Company provides a dental provider organization (DPO) plan.

DeltaCare USA plans are underwritten in these states by these entities: CA — Delta Dental of
California; DC (Policy I-P-DC-dc-25) and FL — Delta Dental Insurance Company; MD and TX — Alpha
Dental Programs, Inc.; UT — Alpha Dental of Utah, Inc.; NY — Delta Dental of New York, Inc.; NV —
Alpha Dental of Nevada, Inc.; PA — Delta Dental of Pennsylvania. Delta Dental Insurance Company acts
as the DeltaCare USA administrator in all these states. These companies are financially responsible
for their own products.

About our DeltaCare® USA networks:
* DeltaCare USA: Network for most group plan members
* DeltaCare USA Individual: Network for Individual plan members (CA only)
* DeltaCare USA Medicare: Network for Medicare Advantage plan members (CA only)
* DeltaCare USA Connect: Network available only to members in select southern California groups


Must be an AARP member to enroll in the AARP Dental Insurance Plan administered by Delta Dental.

The AARP Dental Insurance Plan is insured by Delta Dental Insurance Company, or insured by Dentegra
Insurance Company, or insured by Dentegra Insurance Company of New England (Contract 1230), or
affiliated companies and administered by Delta Dental Insurance Company.

Delta Dental pays royalty fees to AARP for the use of its intellectual property. These fees are used
for the general purposes of AARP. AARP and its affiliates are not insurers. AARP does not employ or
endorse agents, producers or brokers.

Please see the plan policy for a complete description of plan benefits, limitations and exclusions.

Our Delta Dental enterprise includes these companies in these states: Delta Dental of California —
CA, Delta Dental of the District of Columbia — DC, Delta Dental of Pennsylvania — PA & MD, Delta
Dental of West Virginia, Inc. — WV, Delta Dental of Delaware, Inc. — DE, Delta Dental of New York,
Inc. — NY, Delta Dental Insurance Company — AL, DC, FL, GA, LA, MS, MT, NV, TX and UT.

Delta Dental is a registered mark of Delta Dental Plans Association.
